items.quote: Does your real estate company have one or is it just more like a winning and figuring out with every client?
items.statement: Real estate companies may operate without a specific sales process.

items.quote: Or maybe you follow what the client dictates you and end up with ‘I need to think about it…’
items.statement: Clients often respond with 'I need to think about it...' when sales processes are unclear or reactive.

overview: This source chunk presents observations on the effectiveness of sales processes in real estate.
